notes: Red Leaf Yellow Leaf by Lois Ehlert is a non-fiction picture book about the life cycle of a sugar maple tree through the seasons. The hero slot uses a generic tree image since the maple tree is a natural object well-covered by Boardmaker. Key vocabulary centres on autumn colours (red, yellow), plant parts (seed, root), and environmental elements (water, wind, bird). 'Fall' is flagged as ambiguous — use an autumn/falling-leaves image rather than a person falling. The book's strong colour theme makes red and yellow essential fringe words.
